Pony Paper is a live wallpaper (and optional screen saver) using pixel-art sprites of characters from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.

This is a modernization fork of Smithers888/PonyPaper for current Android (Gradle, modern SDK levels). It installs under application id io.github.derram.ponypaper and does not replace the original app.

Fork features include target frame rate, Battery Saver and on-battery options, hold-to-drag ponies, optional screensaver clock (Lexend), custom pony import, and stability fixes.
